records.title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
records.reason: Continuous-latent diffusion LM uses parallel denoising and may be relevant to inference architecture, but full text reports generation quality and sampling steps without latency/throughput or inference-cost measurements. Difficult to establish an efficiency contribution.

records.title: Stable FP4 Training via Transposition-Invariant Block Quantization
records.reason: Primary abstract read at https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24953: Explicitly focuses on FP4 LLM training stability and training precision efficiency; training-only scope.

records.title: MemOps: Benchmarking Lifecycle Memory Operations in Long-Horizon Conversations
records.reason: Primary abstract read at https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12893: Introduces a benchmark for lifecycle memory-operation correctness and failure diagnosis. It does not propose memory compaction or measure inference resource efficiency.
